headline: Founder
name: Jeyavelraj Kondal
title: Founder & Managing Director
paragraphs: With over 25 years of experience across automotive engineering, product development, validation, manufacturing, and supplier development, Jeyavelraj Kondal has led complex engineering programs with global automotive organizations including Bosch, Continental, and Hero MotoCorp.

His expertise spans electrical and automotive systems, product industrialization, reliability engineering, supplier development, and design-to-production execution. At JKINFINIT, he brings this extensive industry experience together with a hands-on, engineering-driven approach to delivering practical solutions for complex technical challenges.
